operating_notes.text: JSW Steel and POSCO Group signed a JV agreement to set up a 6 MTPA greenfield steel plant in Odisha through Saffron Resources Private Limited.

JSW Steel and JFE Steel Corporation unveiled JSW JFE Steel Limited, the new corporate identity for their 50:50 JV encompassing the Sambalpur, Odisha steel plant, marking 15 years of their strategic alliance.
JSW Steel declared preferred bidder for Pissurlem Mineral Block No. XV in Goa with 96 million tonnes of iron ore resources at a bid price of 118.10% of the value of mineral dispatched.
JSW Steel reported consolidated crude steel production of 21.18 Lakh tonnes for April 2026, down 1% YoY. BF3 at Vijayanagar is under shutdown for upgradation.
Board recommended a dividend of ₹7.10 per equity share for FY26.
Board approved the Scheme of Amalgamation of BMM Ispat Limited with JSW Steel Limited with an appointed date of April 1, 2026.
JSW Steel signed MoU for a 300 KTPA green methanol project in Raigad with Bharatia and Carbon Iceland.
JSW Steel commenced project development of a 13.2 MTPA integrated steel plant at Paradeep, Odisha, with an estimated investment of ₹65,000 crore.
NCLT Mumbai Bench sanctioned the Scheme of Amalgamation of Piombino Steel Limited with JSW Steel Limited with an appointed date of January 1, 2026.
Orissa High Court quashed a ₹696.32 Cr shortfall demand and remanded a ₹1,472.69 Cr shortfall demand for the Jajang Iron Ore Block.

Board approved a 5 MTPA expansion and upgradation of existing plant facilities at Sambalpur by JSW JFE Steel Limited with an estimated equity requirement of ₹7,500 crore (₹3,750 crore each from JSW Steel and JFE Steel).
India Capacity Utilisation at 88% in Q2, with BF-3 reaching ~90% utilisation.

timeline.summary: On April 20, 2026, JSW Steel executed a joint venture agreement with POSCO Group to convert its subsidiary Saffron Resources into a 50:50 JV for setting up a 6 MTPA greenfield steel plant in Odisha.
On April 21, 2026, JSW Steel announced the full redemption of USD 750 mn senior unsecured notes by its subsidiary Periama Holdings LLC upon maturity on April 20, 2026.

JSW Steel and JFE Steel Corporation unveiled JSW JFE Steel Limited, the new corporate identity for their 50:50 JV encompassing the Sambalpur, Odisha steel plant, marking 15 years of their strategic alliance.
MR SAKET KANORIA declared no new encumbrances on JSW Steel shares as of April 2, 2026, beyond prior disclosures.
On May 8, 2026, JSW Steel was declared the preferred bidder for the Pissurlem Mineral Block No. XV in Goa with 96 million tonnes of projected iron ore resources.
JSW Steel reported consolidated crude steel production of 21.18 Lakh tonnes for April 2026, down 1% YoY.
JSW Steel reported Q4 FY26 standalone revenue of ₹36,248 Cr and net profit of ₹2,094 Cr, recommending a dividend of ₹7.10 per share.
JSW Steel Limited’s Board recommended a final dividend of ₹7.10 per equity share for FY2026.
JSW Steel's Board approved the scheme of amalgamation of BMM Ispat Limited with an appointed date of April 1, 2026.
Narmada Fintrade Private Limited declared no new encumbrances on JSW Steel shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) as of April 3, 2026.
JSW Steel disclosed the transcript and audio recording of its Q4FY26 earnings call on May 20, 2026.
JSW Steel signed a strategic MoU with Bharatia and Carbon Iceland International during the 3rd India–Nordic Summit to develop a 300 KTPA green methanol project in Raigad, Maharashtra.
JSW Steel commenced project development for its 13.2 MTPA integrated steel plant at Paradeep, Odisha, with an investment of ₹65,000 crore.
JSW Steel announced that its subsidiary JSWSCPL received a letter of intent from the CoC as the successful resolution applicant for Colour Roof India Limited.
Urmila Kanoria declared no new encumbrances on JSW Steel shares beyond prior disclosures, filed April 2, 2026.
JSW Steel received the NCLT Mumbai order sanctioning the amalgamation of Piombino Steel Limited with JSW Steel Limited.
On October 18, 2026, JSW Steel reported that the Orissa High Court quashed a ₹696.32 Cr demand and remanded a ₹1,472.69 Cr demand regarding the Jajang Iron Ore Block.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹54,486 Cr (+20.7% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹5,279 Cr (+225.3% YoY).
JSW Steel's board approved a 5 MTPA expansion of the Sambalpur plant via its JV with JFE Steel for ₹7,500 crore equity, and the incorporation of a UAE subsidiary.
JSW Steel reported consolidated Q2FY27 revenue of ₹54,486 Cr and net profit of ₹5,359 Cr, with net debt dropping to ₹44,482 Cr.
